why: Chris, 10 October 2026: "schedule icon generation for any missing icons in any course". Achievement badges for the 10 courses that have none yet (safety, socialmedia, sql9, pascal9, clubweb, cattheory10/11/12, catexcel, catpowerpoint - their looks added to LOOKS in make_badges.py) plus 2 missing each in catword, cathtml and catdb: about 220 badges. The script makes only badges whose file is missing, straight into public/assets/badges/<course>/ (no picking step, like 2026-10-01-badge-art); Chris checks them on the site.
